reason: The free first visit gets me in the door, and the Montessori-style look plus a seat and coffee while I answer a few emails is something the free options can't give me. I'd pay the $13 drop-in a couple of times, not a membership.
objection: Library storytime and the parks are free, so every visit has to earn its $13. I won't commit to a monthly plan until I know my toddler actually likes it and I can really get some work done there.
would_change_my_mind: Reliable wifi and a seat where I can see my toddler while I work, and a 5-visit pack that doesn't expire quickly.
